title: peplis nummulariifolia var. boraei
intro: Peplis nummulariifolia var. boraei, commonly known as Blue Water Clover, is a plant species in the family Hydrophyllaceae. It is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Peplis nummulariifolia var. boraei include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating respiratory issues and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant are rich in alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
